text:
maya: Heads-up — opened a docs PR (#4129) to clean up dead links in the 429/timeouts runbook and add a tiny repro curl snippet. Can folks triage? low priority but would like to get link rot fixed before the next snapshot.

alex: Taking a look. Can you include a curl that surfaces the Retry-After and X-RateLimit headers? that's super helpful for the SDK retry docs.

maya: Added a minimal curl snippet to the PR and a short note about not using production keys. Example: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <SYNTHETIC_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"small-occtest","prompt":"flood","max_tokens":1}'
```
This shows a 429 response with headers like `Retry-After` and `X-RateLimit-Remaining`.

sam: Can you also add a tiny Node snippet (2–3 lines) showing exponential backoff + jitter? we'll crosslink from the SDK README. If you want, I can draft it in the SDK PR (#4152) but prefer docs to link to it.

julia: Product prefers the runbook be updated first (so support articles point to a stable doc). prioritize doc-first if it's a small change.

ron: Oncall note — please avoid any examples that hit prod endpoints or real tokens. Use clearly synthetic tokens and a note that results are synthetic. Also add a short sentence about how to safely reproduce in staging.

maya: Updated the PR with the curl + a tiny Node snippet. Added a bold callout to use synthetic tokens and a staging repro note. cc @sam for crosslinking.

sam: I can add the same Node example to the SDK PR and include a reference link back to the runbook. Will ping once merged.

alex: Also left a small suggestion to tighten the context-limit guidance (added one para about prompt trimming heuristics and an example command for `context-clipper`). Makes the migration guide clearer for customers moving from long-context models.

maya: Cool — I'll fold that paragraph into this branch.

maya: @ci-bot can we run the linkcheck job on this branch before we merge? :pray:

ci-bot: Linkcheck started for branch docs/4129. Scanning... results: 3 broken links found:
- /v1/examples/old-429 -> 404
- /sdk/python/retries-old -> 404
- /runbooks/timeout-deprecated -> 410

maya: Thanks — patching those broken targets now (rewrites + redirects).

ken: Quick review done — LGTM after one phrasing tweak on the `Retry-After` explanation (clarified units and server behavior).

maya: Phrase tweak applied, expanded note on seconds vs milliseconds. PR ready for merge.

alex: I'll queue for staging docs deploy Thu morning.

bot-deploy: Staging deploy scheduled: 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC.

maya: Great, thanks everyone :tada: closing thread.
